title: GameSmith: Scaling Zero-Sum Self-Play with Synthesised Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.13995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training large language models (LLMs) on two-player zero-sum games provides a verifiable reward, and the gains have been shown to transfer to general reasoning. Existing pipelines, however, rely on a handful of hand-written games and on advantage estimators tied to them, so both the supply of games and the advantage estimate on a large corpus limit scaling. We present GameSmith, which scales both. An LLM synthesises games inside templates whose reward, observation, and hidden-information code is fixed. Each game is verified by seed-paired replay and by an independent re-implementation of its specification, then expanded into encoding, rule, and size variants, giving 26 new games in 29 families and 336 verified variants from the three SPIRAL templates. translated_title: GameSmith：通过合成游戏扩展零和自博弈训练
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13995v1 公告类型：cross（交叉发布）。摘要：在双人零和博弈上对大语言模型（LLM）进行后训练能够提供可验证的奖励，且这些收益已被证明可以迁移至通用推理能力。然而，现有流水线依赖于少量人工编写的游戏以及与之绑定的优势估计器，因此无论是游戏供应量还是大语料库上的优势估计都限制了规模扩展。我们提出 GameSmith，同时扩展这两个方面。由一个 LLM 在模板内合成游戏，这些模板的奖励、观测和隐藏信息代码是固定的。每个游戏通过种子配对的回放（seed-paired replay）以及对其规范的独立重新实现来进行验证，然后扩展为编码、规则和规模等多种变体，从三个 SPIRAL 模板中生成了 26 个新游戏，涵盖 29 个游戏家族和 336 个经过验证的变体。该模型首先从更大的教师模型（Qwen3-32B）在这些游戏上的自博弈中蒸馏而来，随后通过采用 CRAB（一种优势估计器，原文在此处截断……）的自博弈强化学习进行训练。
tldr: GameSmith 通过让 LLM 在固定模板中自动合成并验证大规模新游戏（26 个新游戏、29 个家族、336 个变体），并结合教师模型自博弈蒸馏与 CRAB 优势估计的自博弈强化学习，突破了零和博弈后训练中游戏数量和优势估计难以扩展的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: GameSmith scales zero-sum self-play post-training by having an LLM synthesise and verify hundreds of new games within fixed templates, combining distillation from a larger teacher with CRAB-based self-play reinforcement learning to overcome the scarcity of hand-written games and their tied advantage estimators.
